illustration.note: hard 400px wide at every width; overflows and is clipped at 390 — the original's behaviour

title.note: an h3 at 20px/24px weight 600, left-aligned — NOT an h1

label.note: capital N here; /sign-up says "Phone number". A real cross-screen copy inconsistency in the original, preserved.

inert.note: HARD CONSTRAINT, LOCKED TRUE. See constraints.inertForm.

constraints.separateDesignSystem: This screen belongs to the app host (Vite + React + Mantine), NOT the Webflow marketing site. It renders no marketing nav and no footer. Its tokens live in tokens/themes/auth-light.json under a separate namespace and must never be merged into the marketing set. The two systems share only the two font families and the brand hexes.
constraints.inertForm: HARD CONSTRAINT. The form must have NO action, NO method, NO endpoint and NO fetch. autocomplete="off" everywhere. Submit only preventDefault()s. Nothing typed is stored, transmitted or logged. ANY GENERATED INSTANCE OF THIS TEMPLATE MUST NEVER ACQUIRE CREDENTIAL SUBMISSION. This is enforced by schema const-locks on submit.inert and field.autocomplete, by a semantic-validator check, and by an adversarial test.
constraints.noPanel: There is no card or panel. Content sits flat on #f8f6f5.
constraints.noLegalText: There is no 'by continuing you agree to...' line, no privacy link and no terms link on this screen. Recorded as a fact, not an omission.
constraints.scopeReduction: /sign-up and /welcome were built and then REMOVED on purpose by explicit decision. They must NOT be reintroduced as templates. Their CTAs are now plain external links to the app host.

motion.note: No entrance animations, no scroll animations, no stagger, nothing animating on load. Only control-level transitions exist: input 200ms ease, floating label 200ms ease, button 300ms ease. There is NO spinner — Mantine's Loader CSS is not in the bundle.

responsive.all: Identical at 1440 / 1024 / 390 apart from the content column: 508px inside a 540px container at 1440/1024, 326px at 390. The type scale does not change at all.
responsive.breakpointNote: Mantine's min-width em breakpoints (576/768/992/1200/1408) exist in the bundle but NONE of them fire on this screen.
